title: Bessent confirms he’s living on US military base over Iran fears
html:
TITLE: Bessent confirms he’s living on US military base over Iran fears

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says he’s still living at a US military base, two weeks after an Israeli warning sent him into hiding. It’s the second known Israeli warning that has forced US officials to take extraordinary security measures.
summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says he’s still living at a US military base, two weeks after an Israeli warning.
